blocks.text: TOPRANK Review Academy, a nationwide network of review centers, produced the Top 1 passer and majority of the nursing board exam topnotchers in the recently released August-September 2026 Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE). Dianne Taczon Tolentino, RN of the University of Northern Philippines – Vigan who reviewed at TOPRANK Baguio emerged as the Top 1 passer among the 37,359 PNLE takers. Majority of topnotchers or a total of 44 in the PNLE also reviewed at TOPRANK across the country. TOPRANK has been producing the Top 1 of the PNLE for nine consecutive years, or every year since 2017. Nurse Tolentino is […]...
